description: ADR-0121 amendment A7 (S3 cross-source actions), slice A7-S1 plan-form gold: the plan-form share of the A7.9 plan gold. Every case is pending-owner-approval (A7.9: every batch is reviewed by the owner); nothing here is scored by a model, and no planner prompt names the A7 form yet. Each case holds the owner message, the deployment context by name, and the expected result of the REAL validator (`plan` + `expect`) and/or of the A7.5 step 0 router (`route`). Synthetic names only (BE, FE, #quoky-test, #dev).
